nodes.text: Official Equine Transport Partner | Cathay Cargo x Cavalluna | 官方馬術運輸夥伴｜國泰貨運 x Cavalluna

The magic began long before these world-class performers took the centre stage. Only with the highest level of expertise in live animal logistics could more than 50 star horses make the journey from Liège to Hong Kong for Cavalluna’s Asia debut. Enveloped in temperature-controlled stalls with round-the-clock care, these majestic equine stars shall experience a flight fit for royalty. Because only then can they land in Hong Kong not as weary travellers, but as calm, well-rested superstars, ready to deliver an unforgettable spectacle of their own. Learn more about Cathay Live Animal: https://bit.ly/4qsnRt7 奇幻盛典的序幕，早在世界級表演者踏上舞台前，便已於萬呎高空中昂然展開！超過50匹明星駿馬，在我們的專業動物運送下，從比利時列日遠赴香港，締造 Cavalluna 亞洲首演。 這些駿馬在全程溫控的專屬馬廄中，由專業團隊全天候悉心照料，悠然享受着尊貴無比的高空旅程。縱使千里迢迢，牠們依然氣宇軒昂、神采飛揚，準備以精彩絕倫的演出，為香港觀眾呈獻畢生難忘的壯麗匯演！ 了解更多國泰－動物運送：https://bit.ly/4xOogbw #cathaycargo #weknowhow #cathayliveanimal #aircargo #airfreight #logisticssolutions
